## Checklist
- [ ] `python -m pytest` passes
- [ ] Prompt or model change: I ran `eval/run_eval.py` before and after and pasted the summary
- [ ] No new network request, no telemetry (or PRIVACY.md and docs/THREAT_MODEL.md are updated)
- [ ] The interface stays keyboard operable and uses the app's own controls (no native `<select>`, `alert()`, `confirm()`)
- [ ] New files have the license header (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Docs and CHANGELOG are updated if behavior changed
- [ ] Nothing private is included (no personal paths, e-mails or text from real messages)
